modern: They do not know how many things are meant by the words stealing, sowing, buying, keeping quiet, seeing what ought to be done; for this is not done by the eyes, but by another kind of vision.
original: They know not how many things are signified by the words stealing, sowing, buying, keeping quiet, seeing what ought to be done; for this is not effected by the eyes, but by another kind of vision.
